items.title: connerkward/macos-screen-recorder-system-audio
items.description: macos-screen-recorder (sck-record) — a macOS screen recorder with system audio via ScreenCaptureKit: CLI, no driver, no sudo. Plus a Claude Code skill.

aiReview.summary: Mac-native Swift CLI that muxes ScreenCaptureKit screen frames with system audio into MP4 without virtual audio drivers. Niche, tiny, and sparsely starred; useful for scriptable/headless capture on Ventura+.
evidence: README describes sck-record.swift, ScreenCaptureKit capturesAudio, AVAssetWriter mux, and Screen Recording permission only.
GitHub facts: MIT, not archived, topics include macos/screencapturekit, stargazers_count 3, forks_count 0, pushed_at 2026-08-17.
Limitations section states main display only and Ctrl-C abort without finalizing.
uncertainty: Runtime quality, audio/video sync, and permission UX were not independently tested.
Ongoing maintenance beyond the recorded push date cannot be verified from this snapshot.
aiReview.tagline: Headless CLI screen capture with native system audio
aiReview.description: Build a one-file Swift CLI that records the main display plus system audio via ScreenCaptureKit, no virtual driver or sudo.
pros: Uses Apple ScreenCaptureKit on macOS 13+ to capture system audio without BlackHole, Loopback, or sudo.
Single Swift source (~90 lines) compiles with swiftc and writes H.264/AAC MP4 with documented CLI flags.
MIT-licensed and documents permissions, limitations (main display only, fixed duration), and comparison to screencapture/OBS.
cons: Very low adoption (3 stars, 0 forks) and a sponsored Recall.ai banner in the README.
No window/region capture, no interactive stop, and hardcoded bitrate/codec.
Packaging leans on Claude Code plugin/skill install as much as a standalone developer tool.

reference.excerpt:
# macos-screen-recorder (sck-record)

> ## **Sponsored by Recall.ai - API for desktop recording.**
> If you’re looking for a desktop recording SDK that works across macOS and Windows, consider checking out [Recall.ai's Desktop Recording SDK](https://docs.recall.ai/docs/desktop-sdk), an SDK that records Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, in-person meetings, and more.

*macos-screen-recorder (sck-record) is a macOS screen recorder that captures the screen with system audio via ScreenCaptureKit — CLI, no driver, no sudo — plus a Claude Code skill.*

**Record your macOS screen *with the sound your Mac is playing* — headless, from the CLI — with no virtual audio driver, no BlackHole, no Loopback, no sudo. One Swift file built on [ScreenCaptureKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/screencapturekit), Apple's native capture framework.**

![sck-record usage: a terminal showing the one-line build (swiftc -O sck-record.swift), a 5-second capture writing demo.mp4 at 1920×1
